column1: # The approved backgrounds, as shipped (ERGON-74). One row per field, exactly
# Fetched by `ergon-wallpaper-gen --fetch` (install.sh runs it) from the
# backgrounds-1 release on github.com/jvines/ergonOS, and refused unless its
# sha256 matches this row. Made from the 8K master that was approved on screen:
# averaged 2x2 to 3840x2400, stored as byte planes (lib.pack_field).
#   approved_max   today's code colouring the 8K master, against the approved
#   approved_frac  8K PNG in its palette: the largest difference in any pixel,
#                  of 255, and the share of pixels more than 2 off. A row is
#                  here only if that is at most 1 in 100,000, and none more
#                  than 4 off. All 69 approved masters meet it, in catppuccin,
#                  the palette every 8K master was rendered in.
#   shipped_max    this file against the exact 4K average, at four panel sizes
#   shipped_frac   in two palettes: the largest difference, and the share of
